{{Quote|Without Support, the Alliance war machine would grind to a halt in a matter of months.|[[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]]|<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Support Services''' was a department of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], established to give support to the rest of the Alliance. While not the most glamorous branch of the Rebel Alliance, it was crucial to their success in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As a branch of the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]], Support Services was headed by one of the [[Supreme Allied Commanders]], the [[Chief of Support Services]]. It worked closely with [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|Ordnance and Supply]]; while Ordnance and Supply was responsible for procuring weapons, supplies, and equipment, Support Services was responsible for the physical [[Transport/Legends|transport]] of the items. The [[Ministry of Supply]] within the [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Alliance Civil Government]] also worked closely with Support Services.<ref name="RASB" />

The individual [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]] which made up the bulk of the Alliance's military forces also needed a support network. The [[Atrivis Sector Force]]s, for example, had an "Ordnance and Support" division which combined the functions of Ordnance and Supply and Support Services.<ref name="RASB" />

==Supply fleet==
[[File:Yt1300_cargo_pods.png|thumb|right|300px|A [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] with additional cargo pods, typical of the Alliance Support Services fleet]]

Support Services was responsible for the Rebel supply fleet, a collection of [[Transport/Legends|transports]] ranging from [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]] to [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]]. Most of these ships were slow, poorly armed, and outdated, making them vulnerable to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack. Larger ships were relatively rare. Though the Alliance was actually well supplied from friendly [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworlds]] and Rebel [[Safe world/Legends|safe worlds]], their overstretched fleet made it difficult to keep the fleet and the troops in the field properly supplied. After the [[Evacuation of Yavin]], this situation was aggravated.<ref name="RASB" />

Modified light freighters, such as [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]] with additional external cargo pods, were the most common ships in Support Services. These vessels were usually purchased secondhand, stolen, or salvaged from junkyards, and required skilled (or lucky) mechanics to remain spaceworthy. Their small size made them useful when supplying ships or bases behind Imperial lines. With forged documentation making them appear to be legitimate [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighters]], these Rebel freighters could sometimes land openly at Imperial [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]].<ref name="RASB" />

Medium transports were used by Support Services for fleet replenishment missions which could not be handled by light freighters. Though they were still too small for efficient transport of bulk items such as fuel and food, and were slow and vulnerable in battle, they were versatile enough. The Rebellion's main source of medium transports was [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards, Inc.]], which sold its entire stock at a steep discount after its bankruptcy. Many of these ships were purchased by the Rebellion through intermediaries.<ref name="RASB" />

Support Services had very few [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI transports]] or comparable bulk freighters. Most of these were captured from the Empire, though this was a difficult operation which usually required that the ship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and crew elected to surrender to Rebel forces rather than fight.<ref name="RASB" />

The officers and crew in the support fleet were a varied group. Some were lifelong professional [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] and [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], some of whom were upholding a generations-long family tradition flying the spacelanes. Others were former [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] pilots either too old or too badly injured for combat missions. Some were recent recruits trained at facilities on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]].<ref name="RASB" />

==Safe worlds==
[[File:Battle_of_New_Alderaan.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]], a [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] supported by Support Services]]
Support Services personnel helped to establish [[Safe world/Legends|safe worlds]] such as [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]], [[Flitter (planet)|Flitter]], and [[Stronghold (planet)|Stronghold]] for the Alliance. [[Scout/Legends|Scouts]] searched the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and even beyond, searching for habitable planets and moons which the Rebellion could use as safe havens. Rebel scientists would investigate these newly discovered worlds, confirming that no hidden dangers would prevent successful colonization. Some of these safe worlds, such as [[Sanctuary/Legends|Sanctuary]], were previously inhabited remote settlements which elected to support the Rebellion.<ref name="RASB" />

Support Services was also responsible for taking care of the infrastructure on safe worlds. In time, some of these safe worlds were stable enough to begin exporting raw material for the Alliance to use in its war effort.<ref name="RASB" />

==Medical services==
The [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]], [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]], and other medical personnel in the Alliance Military were also part of Support Services. The medical services of the Alliance ranged from front-line medics attached to ground units, Rebel bases, or [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], to hidden hospitals and roving hospital ships. The best-known of these [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigates]] was the modified [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], but other ships, such as medium transports, were also modified for these purposes.<ref name="RASB" />

==Notable personnel==
{{Quote|Alliance Support Services are the unsung heroes of the Rebellion... With no fanfare, no recognition, no glory, they, daily, risk their lives in the name of freedom in the galaxy.|Arhul Hextrophon|<ref name="RASB" />}}
[[File:GrizzFrix.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Grizz Frix, a Support Services pilot]]
Support Services supplied non-combat personnel throughout the Alliance, including [[Chef/Legends|cooks]], [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] and other medical professionals, and [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]].<ref name="RASB" />

In addition to the personnel serving in Rebel bases, on board ships in the Alliance Fleet, or on the vessels of the supply fleet, many independent operatives were considered part of the Support Services network. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smugglers]] such as [[Tru'eb Cholakk]] and [[Sapphire (smuggler)|Sapphire]] helped bring supplies to the Rebellion, while the [[Shipjacker/Legends|shipjacker]] [[Shen-and-Gretta Pikeual-Angeles|Pike Angeles]] stole Imperial vessels for the Alliance. Some of these agents worked undercover to carry information and important personnel rather than supplies, such as the stage magician [[Leger Demain]] and the starship racer [[Siro Simito]]. Others, including [[Resik (Jillsarian)|Resik]] and [[Ytavarg Aleema]], operated safe houses for the Rebellion. The responsibilities of these solo operatives often overlapped with those of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken's]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]].<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>

Some prominent Support Services personnel were best known for their work with other branches of the Alliance. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Deeve]], a scout who worked with Support Services to establish safe worlds such as [[Apliria]] and New Alderaan, was a member of the [[Task Force on Alliance Security]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> The [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Grizz Frix/Legends|Grizz Frix]] spent most of his career in the Alliance flying transports for Support Services, but was recruited to fly an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] with [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] just before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Grizz Frix in the Databank">{{DB|character|grizzfrix|Frix, Grizz}}</ref>
